parameters.command:
=TOOL=/projects/migration_backend/tools/apiprobe
OUT=/tmp/apiprobe-bin
if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec 9>/tmp/apiprobe.lock; flock 9; fi
if [ ! -f "$OUT/apiprobe.dll" ] || [ "$TOOL/Program.cs" -nt "$OUT/apiprobe.dll" ]; then
  if ! dotnet publish "$TOOL/apiprobe.csproj" -c Release -o "$OUT" -nologo -v q > /tmp/apiprobe-build.log 2>&1; then
    echo "PACKAGE API TOOL could not be built:"; tail -15 /tmp/apiprobe-build.log; exit 0
  fi
fi
dotnet "$OUT/apiprobe.dll" --workspace /projects/migration-{{ $json.jobId }} --package '{{ $json.package }}' --type '{{ $json.type }}' --member '{{ $json.member }}' --tfm '{{ $json.tfm }}' 2>&1 | head -c 14000
exit 0
